log: Enemy revenant used rust blade for 3 damage and took 4 in retaliation.
Enemy death archer used bone bow for 5 damage.
Your swordsman used sword for 3 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
You recruited a swordsman. It acts next turn.
Enemy skeleton used rust blade for 3 damage.

dialogue.speaker: Adept Meri
dialogue.text: The bell does not make the dead. It calls them from these graves. Stand on a grave and I can close the binding.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: We can hit the walls all day and still lose the road. Seal the flanks, protect Meri, then take the bell.

dialogue.speaker: Meri
dialogue.text: My stone sparks hurt bones. Do keep their swords away from me.

dialogue.speaker: Reed gatherer
dialogue.text: We saved what we could. Please make sure the road is still open when our children come home.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: The eastern villages have not seen a lantern in three nights. I have their names here. Someone has to read them.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: Then we get you across. Stay behind the shields. We are not here to win the river; we are here to reach the other bank.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: The ford north of the bridge is still open. And the ferryman hid his purse in the old riverside ruin, if we need supplies.

dialogue.text: Their bowmen are watching the bridge. My spears can hold the banks, but the skeletons will barely feel their points.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: Keep the hammer close. Ivo, find a ford. We need those villages earning for us, not for the tollkeeper.
